mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalCount, COALESCE(SUM(original_amount), 0) AS totalOriginalAmount, COALESCE(SUM(paid_amount), 0) AS totalPaidAmount, COALESCE(SUM(balance_amount), 0) AS totalBalanceAmount, COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 1 THEN 1 END) AS pendingCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 2 THEN 1 END) AS partialCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 3 THEN 1 END) AS settledCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 4 THEN 1 END) AS overdueCount FROM payables WHERE deleted = 0
